description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useAutoScroll' for auto-scrolling virtualized lists during drag operations, replacing dnd-kit's auto-scroll to avoid conflicts with virtualization. It manages scroll behavior based on mouse position near list edges, using requestAnimationFrame for smooth scrolling.

methods.name: useAutoScroll
methods.description: Custom hook to enable auto-scrolling of a react-window list during drag operations, based on mouse position near list edges.
